paragraphs: R. Yehudah son of R. Shimon ben Pazi: Sanhedrin 11b; Berakhot 15a and 15b; Megillah 19b; Sotah 23a; Chullin 7a. R. Zeira said, “When I came up there, I found R. Yehudah son of R. Shimon ben Pazi”—Shabbat 114b; Sukkah 54b. R. Zerika and R. Yannai bar Ammi visited his house.
